properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: hash.js (1.1.7 top-level; 1.1.3 pinned inside ethers@4.0.27) is a declared dependency in package-lock.json — the pure-JS SHA-1/SHA-224/SHA-256/SHA-384/SHA-512 (+RIPEMD-160) implementations used by elliptic (ECDSA/ECDH internals), hmac-drbg, and the web3/ethers Ethereum stack pulled in by ccxt-rest's web3/ethereumjs-util dependencies. No direct call site in the application's own code (app.js/api/ never require it), but it ships in the installed tree. Changeable here — it is a dependency choice.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: md5@2.2.1 is a declared dependency, required by json-schema-deref@0.5.0 and json-schema-deref-sync@0.10.0 (both under oas-tools, which processes the OpenAPI/swagger spec). Used there as a non-security cache/dedup key for JSON schema documents, not for signatures or certificates. The collision-broken hash still ships in the installed tree; changeable here.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: secp256k1@3.6.2 (native bindings) is a declared dependency, required by ethereumjs-util@6.1.0 — a DIRECT dependency in package.json — and by the nested ethereumjs-util@5.2.0 under ethereumjs-tx (web3 stack). Performs secp256k1 ECDSA for Ethereum key/signature operations in ccxt-rest's web3/ethereumjs-abi support. Shor-vulnerable signature primitive (deadline risk, not harvest risk). Changeable here via dependency/algorithm migration.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: ECDSA capability ships in this tree two ways: (a) the JWT path — jsonwebtoken@8.5.1 → jws@3.2.2 → jwa@1.4.1 → ecdsa-sig-formatter@1.0.11 (JOSE ES256 signature formatting; capability present but the app signs tokens with HS256, so not invoked for JWTs); (b) the Ethereum path — elliptic@6.4.1 pure-JS ECDSA over secp256k1 (see LIB-a0bfbc1a and ALG-673c8f24), which does run via the web3 stack. Changeable here.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: keccak@1.4.0 and keccakjs@0.2.3 (pulling browserify-sha3 + sha3) are declared dependencies — Ethereum's Keccak-256 (pre-FIPS-padding SHA-3) hashing, required by ethereumjs-util@6.1.0/5.2.0 and eth-lib@0.1.27 respectively, feeding web3/ethereumjs-abi in ccxt-rest. Quantum-safe per the roster. Changeable here only as dependency versions.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: pbkdf2@3.0.17 (pure-JS) is a declared dependency required by crypto-browserify@3.12.0, parse-asn1@5.1.4 and scryptsy@1.2.1 — the browserify crypto shim and Ethereum keystore key-derivation chain pulled in by the web3 stack. Iteration counts live inside those packages, not in this repo's config. Same package as LIB-ea49d4c1. Changeable here as a dependency version.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: jsonwebtoken@8.5.1 is a DIRECT dependency (package.json) and the only crypto the application's own code invokes: api/helpers/jwt-helper.js signs bearer access tokens with HS256 (secret generated via Math.random at jwt-helper.js:18 — see ALG-7d1fdc12 — and persisted in the JwtData DB table) and swagger.yaml declares the bearerAuth scheme for the private endpoints. Changeable here.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: jws@3.2.2 is a declared dependency — the JWS (JSON Web Signature) serialization layer between jsonwebtoken@8.5.1 and jwa@1.4.1. Live infrastructure for every bearer token the API issues (signed HS256). Changeable here as a dependency version.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: jwa@1.4.1 is a declared dependency — the JOSE algorithm layer under jws/jsonwebtoken that implements HS256 HMAC signing/verification (used live by the API's JWT auth at api/helpers/jwt-helper.js) and ECDSA signature formatting via ecdsa-sig-formatter@1.0.11. Changeable here as a dependency version.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: scrypt-js@2.0.4 is a declared dependency required by ethers@4.0.27 (the web3 stack) — pure-JS scrypt KDF used for Ethereum keystore key derivation. No call site in the application's own code; ships in the installed tree via web3. Related but distinct from the native scrypt@6.0.3/scryptsy@1.2.1 packages also in the tree (ALG-c1f8b585). Changeable here as a dependency version.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: sha.js@2.4.11 is a declared dependency required by create-hash@1.2.0 and create-hmac@1.1.7 (the crypto-browserify stack, itself feeding pbkdf2, secp256k1, parse-asn1 and the web3 browserify shims) — pure-JS SHA-1/SHA-2 implementations. No direct call site in the application's own code, but the implementations ship in the installed tree. Changeable here as a dependency version.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: The md5@2.2.1 package — required by json-schema-deref@0.5.0 and json-schema-deref-sync@0.10.0 under oas-tools (OpenAPI schema processing), used as a non-security cache/dedup key. MD5 is collision-broken, so the inventory keeps it even though the purpose here is caching, not integrity. Changeable here. Canonical entry for the md5 pair (ALG-70109388 links to this).

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: elliptic@6.4.1 is a declared dependency — the pure-JS ECDSA/ECDH implementation over secp256k1 used by create-ecdh@4.0.3 (crypto-browserify), eth-lib@0.1.27, secp256k1@3.6.2, and a nested 6.3.3 under ethers@4.0.27. It is the workhorse signature/key-agreement implementation of the Ethereum stack in this tree; 6.4.1 is an old line predating the 2024-era signature-malleability fixes in the 6.6.x releases. Shor-vulnerable; changeable here via dependency upgrade / algorithm migration.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: hash.js@1.1.7 top-level (1.1.3 pinned inside ethers@4.0.27) — required by elliptic@6.4.1, ethers and hmac-drbg@1.0.1. Pure-JS SHA-1/SHA-2/RIPEMD-160 implementations. No direct call site in app code; ships in the installed tree. Canonical entry for the hash.js pair (ALG-50e53f84 links to this). Changeable here as a dependency version.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: pbkdf2@3.0.17 — required by crypto-browserify@3.12.0, parse-asn1@5.1.4 and scryptsy@1.2.1 (the Ethereum keystore key-derivation chain under web3). Pure-JS PBKDF2; iteration parameters live inside the consuming packages, not in this repo. Canonical entry for the pbkdf2 pair (ALG-4de3b020 links to this). Changeable here as a dependency version.
